LTC.name: LTC
LTC.feeFormula: Litecoin Core wallet fee is selected-rate × serialized transaction bytes (rate in litoshis per 1,000 bytes), subject to wallet/mempool/relay minima and estimator/fallback policy; MWEB transactions also add 100 litoshis per MWEB weight unit in the reviewed source. No universal fixed fee or live quote.
notes: Litecoin Core fee implementation reviewed at pinned repository commit 9fe73a4bd1433f9b90ee0ea5fc6e985b6702d343; wallet estimates/fallbacks and relay/mempool policy are node/wallet state, not a constant network fee. This is not a live mempool quote.
Host/chain identity remains pending separately; fee-model review does not independently confirm registry identity, address conventions or current deployments.

AVAX.name: Avalanche C-Chain (not X/P)
AVAX.feeFormula: C-Chain dynamic fee: gasCharged × min(gasFeeCap, baseFee + gasTipCap); Helicon defines gasCharged = max(gasUsed, gasLimit / 2). Fees are paid and burned in AVAX. Base fee is a changing validator-voted minimum with no protocol upper bound; no live quote.
notes: Historical host mapping and derivation conventions are inventory, not proof of a deployed token or wallet compatibility.
Pinned community chain catalogue, not a live RPC check; primary-reviewed fee mechanics are protocol description, not a live quote or transaction estimate.

Avalanche docs report Helicon/ACP-283 activated on Mainnet September 22, 2026; the validator-voted minimum was reported at 5 nAVAX in late September 2026. The floor is mutable; do not hardcode it as a current fee. eth_baseFee is a worst-case bound since Helicon, while actual charged gas also reflects the gas-limit floor.
